design_direction: Flipper Zero-style multi-tool on native Linux 6.1; not a Flipper Zero firmware port

source_audit.notes: Names/driver sources are proof of source availability, NOT proof that a Linux 6.1 driver is working.

hardware_lock: CLMR/display/touch/radio GPIO DT nodes stay disabled until verified; no phone access or flash in audit

modules.label: Display & Touch
source: Linux 6.1 DRM/panel and touch driver staging
needs: Linux 6.1 DRM/KMS + CLMR/BDIC boot
Synaptics SHTPS port
graphics composition and virtual keyboard

modules.label: Terminal
needs: Booted userspace, writable storage, keyboard/terminal UI
modules.io: PTY local or SSH; terminal stays available if launcher exits

modules.label: Wi-Fi Toolkit
needs: Kernel 6.1 WCNSS/WLAN firmware + netdev
iw list simultaneous AP+managed combination before repeater
modules.io: Scan, station/AP, packet inspection only on authorized networks

modules.label: Bluetooth
source: SHL25 stock hardware Bluetooth support; exact Linux 6.1 controller bringup unresolved
needs: HCI enumeration and firmware verification

modules.label: FeliCa / NFC
needs: Identify controller and firmware/secure-element constraints
Port controller GPIO and communication driver
Verify reader mode; no assumption of card emulation
modules.io: Inventory and own-tag reader tests when hardware validated

modules.label: IrDA / IR
needs: Confirm SHIRBLASTER enabled for AS99 and physical TX/RX circuit
Port UART/IrDA kernel APIs and GPIO pinctrl
Test IR carrier/protocol before remote claims
modules.io: Optical serial, possibly IR blaster after proof

modules.label: Digital TV / UHF RX
needs: Identify tuner/demodulator silicon and user-space blobs
Port GPIO92 DTVEN, GPIO13 DTVRST, PM8841 antenna-select lines
Port actual demodulator + MPEG-TS input and relevant TV standard
No assumed raw IQ output, no TX
modules.io: ISDB-T reception if source/firmware and RF region compatible

modules.label: Sensors & Grip
needs: Port selected AS99 sensor and IRQ/power drivers

modules.label: USB & External Modules
source: Native K34 USB CDC ACM COM21 tested
needs: Verify Linux 6.1 gadget and OTG roles
External USB OTG/serial boards for missing RF features
modules.io: CDC-ACM, serial debug, gadget profiles in controlled lab

modules.label: Sub-GHz Transceiver
source: Flipper Zero contains a dedicated CC1101; no equivalent SHL25 transceiver confirmed
needs: External region-compliant radio transceiver (e.g. USB/SPI board)
Antenna, driver and regulated TX controls
modules.io: No built-in sub-GHz transmit capability established

modules.label: RFID 125 kHz
source: No dedicated 125 kHz LF reader coil/controller established for SHL25
needs: External LF RFID front end and own-tag test
modules.io: Do not equate FeliCa 13.56 MHz with RFID 125 kHz

modules.label: iButton 1-Wire
source: No external iButton contact interface established for SHL25
needs: External 1-Wire interface/contact probe
